Method of Attack: Trojanized Android applications subscribing victims to premium SMS services without their knowledge, charging more than €30 per month
Tricking victims with prize and gift alerts to subscribe to paid services
Using mobile phone number access to initiate premium subscriptions
Attack Vector: Trojanized Android apps delivered via Google Play Store and third-party app stores
Installation of malicious apps on victim's phone
Indicators of Compromise: Apps removed from Google Play Store but still available on third-party repositories
Victims subscribed to premium SMS services charging recurring payments
